description: List one platform's collection with its own filters, for collections a plain search cannot reach (USAJOBS by department, SEC filings by CIK, OSV advisories by package). Costs 1 credit. Every row has name (platform/collection/id), kind, its fields and source {platform, url, license, attribution, fetched_at, terms_url}; quote source.attribution when you show a row.

filters.description: Collection filters as data_list_sources lists them, such as {"country": "VNM", "indicator": "NY.GDP.MKTP.CD"}.

page_token.description: next_page_token from the previous answer, for the next page.

platform.description: Platform id from data_list_sources, such as usajobs.

name: data_list
title: List one data collection
